subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Abundant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ample**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"abundant"** means something that exists or is available in large quantities; more than enough. (प्रचुर मात्रा में)

 
 
• **Example:** The garden was abundant with flowers of every kind.
 
 
 
• **"Ample"** refers to something that is enough or more than enough; plentiful. (पर्याप्त)
 
 
• **Example:** There was ample time to finish the project before the deadline.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'abundant'** is **'ample'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ample**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Elusive** (चतुर): Difficult to find, catch, or achieve.

 
 
• **Example:** The elusive thief was finally caught by the police.
 
 
 
• **Skimpy** (अल्प): Lacking in size, fullness, or sufficiency.
 
 
• **Example:** She wore a skimpy dress to the party.
 
 
 
• **Rare** (दुर्लभ): Not occurring very often.
 
 
• **Example:** It is rare to find such a talented artist.`
